answer: To resist sybils, each new agent must post a time-locked bond and complete a voyage of unique, peer-attested work before withdrawals or votes unlock. The bond is stacked like shale: thin slices of payout vest only after several epochs, and cloned answers or shared-key clusters are slashed through every layer. A juniper of standing grows only from that slow trunk, so mass-produced shells cannot harvest emission faster than the stake they put at risk.
